mode.title: Protection mode
mode.description: audit: log only, never interrupt. smart: block attacks, warn on doubtful commands (default). strict: every warning blocks.

lang.title: Warning language
lang.description: auto follows the browser language; en, hi or kn forces English, Hindi or Kannada.

trustedSites.title: Trusted sites
trustedSites.description: Hosts (and their subdomains) whose warnings are skipped, such as the college's own documentation site. Blocks still apply.

contact.title: Help-desk WhatsApp number
contact.description: Digits with country code. 'Ask someone I trust' sends the warning here.

allowCopyAnyway.title: Allow 'Copy anyway'
allowCopyAnyway.description: false removes the option to restore a blocked copy.

reportLures.title: Offer 'Report this page'
reportLures.description: Shows a button on blocked pages that opens Google Safe Browsing's report form. Nothing is sent unless the user clicks.

blockedHosts.title: Blocked hosts
blockedHosts.description: A command that would contact one of these hosts (or a subdomain) is always blocked. Generate the list from the fleet view's lure sites.

approvedCommands.title: Approved commands
approvedCommands.description: SHA-256 fingerprints (from 'owlcept hash') of exact commands that never prompt, such as the organisation's own setup scripts.

deviceLabel.title: Device name in exports
deviceLabel.description: Label shown for this device in the fleet view.
